subject: Maths
title: Angles in polygons
subtitle: Angles · KS3 Maths
learning_objective: I can find interior and exterior angles of regular and irregular polygons.

key_vocab.definition: The sum of interior angles of a polygon with n sides is (n − 2) × 180°.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can find interior and exterior angles of regular and irregular polygons.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: interior angles -- The sum of interior angles of a polygon with n sides is (n − 2) × 180°.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Interior angle sum = (n − 2) × 180°. Exterior angles always sum to 360°.
Sum = (n − 2) × 180°
n = number of sides

Key examples:
  ✓ Triangle: (3−2)×180 = 180°  (angle sum)
  ✓ Quadrilateral: (4−2)×180 = 360°  (angle sum)
  ✓ Pentagon: (5−2)×180 = 540°  (angle sum)
  ✗ Hexagon interior sum = 600°  (should be 720°)
  ✗ Exterior angles sum to 180°  (always 360°)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – interior angle sum
  Find the sum of interior angles of a hexagon.
  A hexagon has 6 sides, so n = 6
  (6 − 2) × 180 = 4 × 180
  = 720°
  = 720°
  (Always subtract 2 from the number of sides first.)

Example 2 – one interior angle (regular)
  Find one interior angle of a regular octagon.
  Sum = (8 − 2) × 180 = 1080°
  Regular: all angles equal
  1080 ÷ 8 = 135°
  = 135°
  (For regular polygons, divide the total by the number of sides.)

sections.title: Missing angles
sections.content:

(a) Triangle: 60°, 80°, x
(b) Quadrilateral: 90°, 85°, 110°, x
(c) Pentagon: 100°, 110°, 120°, 130°, x
(d) Hexagon: 130°, 140°, 100°, 110°, 120°, x

sections.title: Mixed polygon problems
sections.content:
Answer each question.

(a) How many sides if interior sum = 1260°?
(b) Each exterior angle is 40°. How many sides?
(c) Interior angle of regular polygon = 156°. How many sides?
(d) Sum of exterior angles of a 100-sided polygon?
(e) Interior angle of regular 12-sided polygon?

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ Interior angles of a hexagon sum to 720°
✗ Exterior angles always sum to 180°
✓ A regular polygon has all angles equal
✗ Interior angle sum of a quadrilateral is 180°
✓ Exterior angle = 360° ÷ n for regular polygons
